name: Bauernhof Friedl
beschreibung: The Bauernhof Friedl is located in Pfafflar, Tirol, in a remote side valley. The holiday apartments are rustic and functionally furnished. The accommodation is a starting point for tours into the Lechtaler Alpen. Pfafflar is a small village without through traffic. Guests can enjoy the silence of the mountain world. Regional products from the farm are offered. The landscape is suitable for extended hikes and ski tours in winter.
